mapper.select: SELECT id, character_id, title, description, damage_total, video_url, combo_file_url, created_by, status, created_at, updated_at FROM combos WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, character_id, title, description, damage_total, video_url, combo_file_url, created_by, status, created_at, updated_at FROM combos WHERE character_id = #{characterId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT c.id, c.character_id, c.title, c.description, c.damage_total, c.video_url, c.combo_file_url, c.created_by, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar FROM combos c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.created_by = u.id WHERE c.character_id = #{characterId} AND c.status = #{status} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO combos (character_id, title, description, damage_total, video_url, combo_file_url, created_by, status) VALUES (#{characterId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{damageTotal}, #{videoUrl}, #{comboFileUrl}, #{createdBy}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.character_id, c.title, c.description, c.damage_total, c.video_url, c.combo_file_url, c.created_by, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ch.name_zh), ''), ch.name_en) AS character_name FROM combos c LEFT JOIN characters ch ON c.character_id = ch.id WHERE c.created_by = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
